description: This file defines URL routing for the Django REST Framework API in a Django e-commerce project. It includes route configurations for products, wishlists, reviews, user orders, payments, coupons, refunds, and health checks, integrating ViewSets and APIView classes.

classes.name: DefaultRouter
classes.description: A router from Django REST Framework that automatically generates URL patterns for ViewSets.

classes.name: HealthAPIView
classes.description: An API view for health check status.

classes.name: PublicItemListAPIView
classes.description: API view for listing public items.

classes.name: PublicItemDetailAPIView
classes.description: API view for detailed view of a single public item.

classes.name: AdminItemListCreateAPIView
classes.description: Admin API view for listing and creating items.

classes.name: AdminItemDetailAPIView
classes.description: Admin API view for item detail, update, delete.

classes.name: MyOrdersListAPIView
classes.description: API view for listing user orders.

classes.name: MyOrderDetailAPIView
classes.description: API view for specific order details.

classes.name: DummyPaymentSimulateAPIView
classes.description: API view to simulate payment in testing.

classes.name: AdminCouponListCreateAPIView
classes.description: Admin API for coupons listing and creation.

classes.name: AdminCouponDetailAPIView
classes.description: Admin API for coupon detail, update, delete.

classes.name: AdminOrderStatusTransitionAPIView
classes.description: Admin API for transitioning order statuses.

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Converts class-based views into callable view functions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers ViewSets with the router to generate URL routes.
